text.tspan: Number of one-year-olds who have received different vaccinations World
Estimated number of one-year-olds who have received vaccinations for different diseases.

tspan.tspan: UN, World Population Prospects (2024); WHO & UNICEF (2025)
This includes diphtheria, pertussis and tetanus (3rd dose), measles (1st dose), hepatitis B (3rd dose), polio (3rd dose), Haemophilus

text.tspan: influenzae b (3rd dose), rubella (1st dose), rotavirus (final dose), yellow fever (1st dose), and inactivated polio (first dose).
